Professional Summary

Experienced Database Developer with over 9 years of expertise in Database Design and Development, data Modeling, Performance Tuning, Data Architecture Data Engineer,Data Analysis and Reporting, Backup and Recovery, Security and Access Control, Stakeholder Collaboration, Automation and Scripting and Validation, Cloud Migration, Normalization(3NF) and Relational Database Optimization. Power BI, with hands-on experience in cloud platforms including Azure, AWS and GCP.

Technical Skills

Databases: MySQL, MSSQL, T-Sql • Data Modeler Tools: Erwin, dB schema • Database Migration Tools: Flyway • Techniques: Normalization, Star/Snowflake Schema, SCD, • Reporting/Visualization: Power BI, MS Excel • Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP • Version Control: GitHub • Employment Details

iNova Software Services Bangalore Aug 2025 – Till Date Senior Data Engineer

Developed complex SQL procedures, views, and functions for business-critical applications. • Designed normalized and dimensional data models for OLTP and OLAP systems. • Supported Power BI and SSAS models for enterprise reporting.

Qentelli Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad Oct 2020 – June 2025 Senior Software Engineer

Developed and optimized database schemas,3NF, stored procedures, triggers, and views. • Designed multi-tenant data models with tenant isolation and scalable growth strategies. • Optimized data models for high-volume transactional systems and large-scale reporting workloads. • Implemented slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1 & 2) for analytical and warehouse models • Designed models supporting role-based access control (RBAC), column-level security, masking, and encryption.

Perform metadata analysis, including entity/attribute naming, definitions, data types, lengths, and lineage. • Involved in performance tuning, query optimization, and database monitoring. • Work in Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver high-quality data solutions.

DigiConnectt Technologys Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore July 2017 – April 2020

Database Developer

Designed Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models for OLTP and OLAP systems based on business requirements.

• Built lookup and reference tables to standardize master data and reduce redundancy. • Act as a bridge between business and IT teams, ensuring clarity and alignment throughout the SDLC. • Created and maintained data dictionaries, metadata, and ER diagrams for documentation and governance. • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.

Developed and normalized database designs for CRM and VFM platforms.

TechVerve Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore

June 2015 – June 2017

Software Engineer

Designed Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models for OLTP and OLAP systems based on business requirements.

Translated complex business rules into normalized (3NF) relational schemas with clear entity relationships. • Defined primary keys, surrogate keys, foreign keys, and constraints to ensure data integrity and consistency. • Own and produce data modeling and analysis artifacts to support development teams.

Visionet Systems Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore Oct 2013 – Dec 2014 Associate

Created and maintained schematics for Oil Gas industry projects.

Project Work

RTMEC is a MEP and Civil engineering firm that goes beyond a typical consulting role. They become a partner to their clients by aligning with the goals, processes and people at each organization.

TED is a monitoring and analytics console that provides AI-powered actionable insights to leaders and engineering teams. TED delivers highly configurable dashboards and reports to suit the needs of a variety of business needs. Its intelligent recommendations are based on the data from past and present events.

Mobe Discovery and test management in simple English automation platform for modern continuous engineering teams that integrates into your EngineeringOps ecosystem seamlessly. Trigger based auto- matic ticket creation and configurable two-way communication with other tools. Improved intelligence in healing tests on their own and Deliver world class digital experiences by validating your applications using reliable automation tests.

LConnectt empowers sales teams to achieve success by ensuring each lead is touched upon. No more ‘hot’, ‘warm’ and ‘cold’ leads without quantitative methods to define these buckets. SimplifAI uses a combination of AI and ML to analyse and forecast.

VFM gives businesses a platform to capture, identify, analyse and learn from Their customer con- versations. Captures voice-based feedbacks via Automated calls Uses AI, ML to analyse and capture key sentiments and Net Promoters Score (NPS), Identifies top keywords, business classifiers, KPI and much more.

BankVerve provides technology solutions in Financial, e-governance and Education area. They de- liver production which helps to build customer intimacy and competitive advantage through cost effective solutions while adhering to dynamic stringent regulatory environment.

Education

Master of Computer Applications (MCA), KSOU Mysore University, 2015 • Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), Bangalore University, 2012

Projects and Achievements

TED Dashboard: Developed AI-powered insights console for engineering teams. • VFM Analysis: Integrated Twilio for voice feedback and sentiment analysis. • CRM Optimization: Enhanced database performance by 25% via redesign.

Hobbies

Travelling, Listening and playing music, Playing shuttle.
